quote: This paper introduces a conceptual framework for Natural Language Generation (NLG) in variably complex communicative scenarios [...] and then, in two case studies, we provide suggestions for their operationalisation in classic NLG tasks.

In this section, we demonstrate how to use our framework to conceptualise a communication scenario that corresponds to a classic NLG task, referring expression generation ... we also apply it to text summarisation, a widely studied NLG (and NLU) task.
